verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own on-device architecture keeps prompts, audio and images on the device. Hosted execution happens only when the user explicitly chooses it, so local-mode data never reaches the vendor and cannot be trained on. This is inferred from data locality, not stated as a training policy: the docs never address training use, and nothing covers what happens to data sent to Wally Cloud. Missing for 10: explicit no-training policy or opt-out control, training-use terms for Wally Cloud hosted requests, independent verification beyond a single community 'no data is collected' reply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Prompts, audio, and images stay on the phone, and everything keeps working with no network.
A request only leaves your machine _when you say so_.
Hosted and local execution are explicit choices. Wally does not silently move a request between them.
Private by default. Offline by design.
Fully local - no data is collected!!
